alerts.plain_language_summary: Participation is visible across the public sample, but the read is still fragile.
alerts.public_read: Participation is visible across the public sample, but the read is still fragile.
alerts.segment: all, fresh_pairs, high_caps, majors, micro_caps, mid_caps
alerts.title: Broad but fragile participation
alerts.what_would_confirm: The read strengthens if participant outcome improves and risk flags fade.
alerts.what_would_weaken: It weakens if outlier behavior or window disagreement remains dominant.
alerts.why_it_matters: This matters because broad activity can still be unstable when confirmation or outcome is weak.

alerts.plain_language_summary: The public read may be leaning on a small number of strong moves.
alerts.public_read: The public read may be leaning on a small number of strong moves.
alerts.segment: all, fresh_pairs, high_caps, majors, micro_caps, mid_caps
alerts.title: Move may be outlier-driven
alerts.what_would_confirm: The read strengthens when gains broaden beyond outlier moves.
alerts.what_would_weaken: It weakens if concentration remains high or broader windows disagree.
alerts.why_it_matters: This matters because narrow leadership can make the market condition fragile.

alerts.plain_language_summary: The market condition is visible, but the clean public sample is still thin or building.
alerts.public_read: The market condition is visible, but the clean public sample is still thin or building.
alerts.segment: all, fresh_pairs, high_caps, majors, micro_caps, mid_caps
alerts.title: Read may be unreliable
alerts.what_would_confirm: More clean public sample needs to support the same condition.
alerts.what_would_weaken: It weakens if source freshness stays limited or unresolved coverage remains high.
alerts.why_it_matters: This matters because thin reads can shift quickly and should not be treated as fully confirmed.

alerts.plain_language_summary: A cap-band slice is moving differently from the broader chain read.
alerts.public_read: A cap-band slice is moving differently from the broader chain read.
alerts.title: Cap-band read needs context
alerts.what_would_confirm: The read strengthens if the cap-band move aligns with broader market windows.
alerts.what_would_weaken: It weakens if the cap-band remains isolated or the sample stays thin.
alerts.why_it_matters: This matters because narrow rotation can look strong before broader participation confirms it.

alerts.plain_language_summary: The current market condition is forming, but confirmation is incomplete.
alerts.public_read: The current market condition is forming, but confirmation is incomplete.
alerts.segment: all, fresh_pairs, high_caps, majors, micro_caps, mid_caps
alerts.title: Move has not confirmed yet
alerts.what_would_confirm: The same read needs to hold across refreshes and broader windows.
alerts.what_would_weaken: It weakens if the next public refresh disagrees or participation fades.
alerts.why_it_matters: This matters because an early read can fail if it does not persist across refreshes.

alerts.plain_language_summary: The market is active, but the public sample does not yet show a clear participant outcome.
alerts.public_read: The market is active, but the public sample does not yet show a clear participant outcome.

alerts.title: Participant outcome unclear
alerts.what_would_confirm: The read strengthens when outcome resolves from unclear into a stable public read.
alerts.what_would_weaken: It weakens if outcome remains unclear while risk flags grow.
alerts.why_it_matters: This matters because active markets can still punish participation when outcome is unclear.

alerts.plain_language_summary: The public read is available, but source freshness or data quality is limiting confidence.
alerts.public_read: The public read is available, but source freshness or data quality is limiting confidence.

alerts.what_would_confirm: The read strengthens when fresher public coverage supports the same condition.
alerts.what_would_weaken: It weakens if freshness remains limited or sample quality deteriorates.
alerts.why_it_matters: This matters because stale or thin coverage can make a current read unreliable.

alerts.public_read: Broader context is previewed publicly, while full macro and advanced context remain gated.

alerts.what_would_weaken: It weakens if broader context conflicts with the on-chain read.
alerts.why_it_matters: This matters because wider conditions can support, conflict with, or fail to confirm the on-chain read.
